artworks.title: The Holy Family at the Bank of the River
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of people. On the right, there is a person standing next to a donkey. Riding on the donkey is a cloaked person with a halo around their head who is cradling something. Opposite them, on the left, a winged person is guiding a boat with a pole. The people are dressed in flowing garments. In the background is a flat landscape leading up to the body of water on the left. The sky features many large, billowing clouds with rays of light shining through them.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Preparing to Embark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and a boat by a shore. The image depicts three figures on a flat piece of land near a body of water, possibly ready to embark on or disembarking from a boat depicted on the right. Additional figures or entities might be present, indicated by outlines and soft textures. Their arrangement and attire convey an inclination towards classical or mythological themes. The scene includes detailed textures such as the flowing fabric of garments, the feathered wings, and natural elements like grass and water. The sky has light clouding, adding to the atmosphere of the scene. The drawing is rendered with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating depth and dimension.

artworks.title: The Madonna, Child, and Angels Entering the Boat
artworks.description: This print shows several people in a boat. In the center of the image is a small rowboat that we see from the side, stretching horizontally across the print, facing right. On it there are several people. On the right is an old, bearded man wearing a tunic and holding a walking stick. There is a white halo around his head. His arm is around a woman on the left. The woman is stepping up onto a plank on the boat, reaching towards the man with one arm. In her other arm, she appears to hold a small child, although the child is covered in the large fabric cloak that drapes around the woman. She also has a halo above her head. On either side of her, winged angels are reaching for her, appearing to help her move farther into the boat. Rays of light shine down on them from the clear sky. In the background on the left are tall, leafy trees, and on the right there are several low hills across the water.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Being Ferried Across the River
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a small boat on a body of water. The point of view is slightly elevated, with the horizon separating the cloudy sky from the waterscape. A flock of birds is dispersed in the sky. A boat with figures, including one with wings, a rowing man, and a woman holding a child, is visible. The etching features intricate lines creating detailed textures in the figures and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white for contrast and depth. In the distance, a group of trees with leafy canopies fills the right half of the composition.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Disembarking
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures traveling near a body of water with a donkey, a boat, and an angelic figure in the foreground. Trees and a distant horizon line create depth, while birds fly in the sky. The use of hatchings and fine lines adds texture to the scene, conveying a narrative moment with dynamic energy and detail.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight with Joseph in Adoration
artworks.description: This is a print of a scene beneath a canopy of trees. In the center, a child sits on the lap of a woman reclining under a tree. Both of them have halos of light around their heads. A third person with a halo is standing on the left, and he approaches the woman and child with his arm outstretched. This central group of people is surrounded by winged angels on either side of the tree. A donkey sits below the tree in the bottom right corner of the print. Rays of light shine down on the scene from the top-left corner.

artworks.title: The Flight with Obelisk at the Left
artworks.description: This print depicts three human figures and a donkey. Near the bottom right corner, one person is sitting on the donkey, their back to us. They are covered with draped white cloth and have a halo around their head. They appear to hold a small bundle on their lap. An angel stands in front of this person, its long wings raised. On the left, another person is walking in front, holding the donkey's reins as it walks over a small hill. This person also has their back to us and wears a loose-fitting cloth tunic while holding a long staff. A halo is in the sky over their balding head. On the far left is a tall stone tower with birds flying around it. Cherubs are flying above the figure on the donkey, surrounded by clouds and rays of light in the otherwise empty sky.

artworks.title: The Flight with Joseph in the Foreground
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with figures moving along a curved path. The horizon is low, with wispy clouds and hills in the distance. A small structure is visible on the horizon. The detailed etching lines capture texture of trees and clothing. In the foreground, there are sheep and a group of figures, including a man, a woman with a child on a donkey. Tall trees are on the right side. The color scheme is monochrome, using blacks, grays, and whites to emphasize texture and shading.

artworks.title: The Episode of the Falling Idol
artworks.description: This print shows a detailed wooded landscape. On the left, there is a headless female statue in a draped garment, standing on a pedestal near a with path through the dense trees. On the right, a man with a staff leads a donkey carrying a woman with a child along the path. The man looks back over his shoulder toward the statue. In gaps through the trees, patches of white sky can be seen.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight, with Holy Family under a Tree
artworks.description: This is an etching depicting a scene with people under a leafy canopy. The central group includes two reclining adults, a man and a woman, both wearing draped clothing. A child rests on the lap of the woman and has a halo of light around their head. They rest under large trees and are surrounded by branches and logs. To the left of the group, a donkey sits on the ground. Above the donkey, there is an opening in the foliage, showing a distant cliff or rock face. The color scheme is monochrome, with dark lines on off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Flight, Joseph at Right and Mary and Angel at Left
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a donkey with a large basket on their back, led or accompanied by another person. The scene is set under leafy trees with dramatic line work. The landscape has a rugged terrain with rocks and vegetation. The composition is dynamic with strong lines and texture, showing movement and narrative.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child at Left, with a File of Angels
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man leading a donkey across a rocky landscape. Tall trees with dense foliage provide a backdrop. Additional figures in flowing robes are on the left. Birds are flying in the sky above, with clouds framing the upper portion of the image. The drawing is detailed with a linear style and cross-hatching emphasizing contours and textures.

artworks.title: The Flight, with Madonna at Right Supported by Angels
artworks.description: The image features a detailed etching showing a man riding a donkey on a rocky path. In the distance, a coastal landscape with buildings is visible. The sky is lightly sketched with birds flying. On the right, two winged figures accompany a person in a robe. Fine lines and cross-hatching are used for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with dark strokes on light paper. The top right corner shows foliage.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Arriving at a City Gate
artworks.description: This print shows a scene under a stone archway involving animals and various people. On the right, a dense group of people stand on a bridge that passes under a tall stone archway. Many of the people are draped in fabric with hoods or head coverings, and many carry objects like baskets or jugs. A lantern hangs from the ceiling of the archway, and there is a large column to its left. On the left side of the print, a group with a donkey approaches the large crowd, heading towards the archway. We see the donkey from the side, and it appears to have a large bundle strapped to it. A person shrouded in a white cloth sits atop the donkey. This person’s face is partially visible facing the left, and white rays form a halo around their head. They appear to hold a small child close to them, and the child also has a halo. Standing slightly behind them and to the left, an old man walks beside the donkey, with a white beard and bald head. He holds a long staff and has a halo. In the top left corner, a small area of sky is visible, with some clouds and a few birds flying overhead.

artworks.title: The Theatre of Water (Le Théâtre d'Eau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Pierre S. du Pont
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with a crowd of people, fountains, and lush greenery. The aerial view captures the scene with intricate details, rich colors, and a formal atmosphere. The crowd, fountains, trees, and horizon create a structured composition. The painting style appears meticulous and detailed with a rich color palette emphasizing the elegance and grandeur of the garden setting.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: The image shows a naked male figure tied to a tree with ropes. The figure appears to have long hair, a beard, and facial features. He is slumped over with his head tilted to the side, and arms and legs stretched out. An arrow is shown piercing his side and underarm. Surrounding the figure are small cherubs with wings, two of which are hovering in clouds on the left. The background features clouds, hills, trees, and a distant house, with a bearded man in draped clothing visible in the upper right among the clouds.

artworks.title: Nude Woman Carrying Vase on Head
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson

artworks.title: Figure Bending Forward with Right Knee Raised
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: The image shows a side view sketch of a person in a bent-over position with one knee raised. The person's arms are bent at the elbows, with hands near the chest. Facial features are simple, and the hair is short or pulled back. The person is nude, and the background is plain beige with no other details.

artworks.title: Figure Facing Forward
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This painting is a sketch of a human figure in motion. The person stands, facing us, with one foot in front of the other and their arms outstretched. Their hand on the left curves downward, while their hand on the right curves up in an impossible position. Their head is turned down and to the left, and they look downward with a neutral expression. They appear to have some kind of cloth around their head, or some sort of hat with a long feather. On their left side are several curving gray lines, perhaps indicating movement or shadow. Their body has been painted in light brown, and the background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Rear View of Female Figure in Action
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This painting shows a nude person standing with their back to us. They are drawn with simple lines, one hand on their hip and the other hand raised next to their head. Their legs are close together, with their feet crossed at the ankles. The person's brown hair is styled in a bun or pulled over one shoulder. The person's skin is mostly painted with a light peachy tone, but there are areas of dark, irregular spots that have the impression of discoloration. The background is plain beige paper. In the bottom right corner, there is handwritten text.

artworks.title: Dancing Figure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: A woman stands balanced on one foot and reaches overhead and holds the other foot with at least one arm in this vertical drawing on now-yellowed paper. The person is outlined in graphite and filled in loosely with a peach color. The head is sketched as a round circle with a few sweeping lines suggesting tendrils of hair. Graphite writing in the lower right corner reads, “homage a Madame K. Simpson A. Rodin 11 octobre 1905.”

artworks.title: Two Figures
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This painting shows two nude people depicted from head to toe. One person stands, supporting the other, who seems to be leaning backwards with one of their feet raised from the ground. The leaning person has their back to us, and the standing person has their head bent down so we don't see their face. They both have pale peach skin and brown hair, and their bodies are drawn with simple gray lines without much detail. The background is beige paper, with a few faint, wavy lines by the feet of the people.

artworks.title: Seated Female Nude Leaning to the Left
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (folded sh): 31.2 x 20 cm (12 5/16 x 7 7/8 in.)
overall (unfolded): 31.2 x 40 cm (12 5/16 x 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This is a pencil drawing of a nude woman who appears to be sitting with her knees crossed. The woman’s head is tilted backward with her chin slightly raised, one arm bent at the elbow with her hand below her chin. Her facial features are lightly sketched, focusing on the outline of her nose and eyes, and her hair appears short. The background is plain, beige paper, and in the bottom right corner there are a few lines of handwriting.

artworks.title: Seated Female Nude Looking Forward
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (folded sh): 31.2 x 20 cm (12 5/16 x 7 7/8 in.)
overall (unfolded): 31.2 x 40 cm (12 5/16 x 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This sketch depicts the full figure of a person standing, with one arm bent upwards above the head and the other resting near the thigh. The facial features are abstract, with forward-facing eyes and a neutral expression. The hair is indicated with loosely curved lines. The figure is not wearing any clothing, but details of the human form are suggested. In the lower left corner, handwritten text appears. The paper background is plain, emphasizing the fluid lines of the drawing.
